description: Three linked documentary photographs of smallholder cultivation in Kenya, human–dog companionship, and an active astronomical research telescope.

images.title: Farmer cultivates a rocky smallholding in Kenya
images.summary: A farmer stands among his planted field and rocky terrain in western Kenya in August 2017. Small-scale food growing adapts to local soil, water and landscape conditions.
images.alt: A farmer stands beside young green crops and large rocks on reddish earth with trees and village houses beyond the field.
images.caption: One photographed smallholder agricultural landscape in Kenya. This image does not represent all rural communities or claim a particular conservation practice.
images.rights: CC BY-SA 4.0 International (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/). Photograph © Georg.Israel; resized derivative under same share-alike license. Subject's personal image-use consent was not independently confirmed; editorial review pending.
images.processing: Source photograph resized to a maximum dimension of 1800 pixels and encoded as a JPEG at quality 87 for the development archive. Original source image and author preserved; no synthetic content.

images.title: Human companionship with a domestic dog
images.summary: The photographer's hand pets a brown-and-white domestic dog, illustrating one personal relationship between humans and other living species.
images.alt: Close-up looking downward at a human hand gently touching the neck and head of a brown-and-white dog beside a fabric-covered object.
images.caption: People and domestic dogs have longstanding relationships that include work, care and companionship. This is one ordinary interaction photographed in November 2025.
images.rights: CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication by the photographer as stated on the linked Commons file page.
images.processing: Source photograph resized to a maximum dimension of 1800 pixels and encoded as a JPEG at quality 87 for the development archive. Original source image and author preserved; no synthetic content.

images.title: A telescope oriented toward the unknown
images.summary: An observatory telescope at the University of Saskatchewan sits under its open dome, showing a real instrument used to gather evidence about objects beyond Earth.
images.alt: Large blue-and-gray astronomical telescope inside a white ribbed domed observatory, with the roof slit open to the sky.
images.caption: Humanity still has many unanswered questions about the universe. This real telescope is one example of how observations can test hypotheses; the image does not itself demonstrate any specific discovery.
images.rights: CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication granted by the photographer on the linked Wikimedia Commons file page.
